# calendar
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package calendar is days without hours: when a fair starts and ends, or which day a sale was made. It reads and writes them as ISO text ("2026-04-18") and in Spanish words ("18 abr 2026").

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `func DayWords(date Date) string` | DayWords is a day without its year, for lists that are all of one year: "24 oct". |
| `func LongRangeWords(start, end Date, thisYear int) string` | LongRangeWords writes when something happens as people say it, the year only when it is not this year's: "Sábado 7 de noviembre" for one day, "12 y 13 de diciembre" for two, "12 al 14 de diciembre" for more, "30 de noviembre al 2 de diciembre" across months. |
| `func LongWords(date Date) string` | LongWords writes a date out as people say it: "viernes, 23 de octubre". |
| `func MonthTitle(date Date) string` | MonthTitle is a month as a wall calendar heads it: "Noviembre 2026". |
| `func MonthWords(date Date) string` | MonthWords is a month and its year: "noviembre de 2026". |
| `func RangeWords(start, end Date) string` | RangeWords writes two dates repeating only what changes: "18–19 abr 2026", "30 abr – 2 may 2026". |
| `func ShortWeekday(date Date) string` | ShortWeekday is the day of the week of date as a calendar's heading writes it: "mié". |
| `func Typed(date Date) string` | Typed writes a date the way the artist types one: "18/4/2026". |
| `func Words(date Date) string` | Words writes the date the Spanish way, with a short month: "18 abr 2026". |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeInvalidDate Code = "calendar.invalid-date"` | CodeInvalidDate is the code of text that is not a stored date. |
| `type Date struct{ ... }` | Date is one day of the calendar, with no hour and no time zone. |
| `func Of(moment time.Time) Date` | Of is the day a moment falls on, in its own time zone. |
| `func Parse(text string) (Date, error)` | Parse reads a stored date ("2026-04-18"). |
| `func ParseTyped(text string) (date Date, found bool)` | ParseTyped reads a date typed as day/month/year ("18/4/2026", "18-04-2026"); found is false for anything else, including days a month does not have. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the calendar: its code, the text it was about and the cause underneath. |
